incremental_assessment.reason: The accepted exporter has no incremental or prior-tree input. It refuses an existing output/partial, rebuilds route lookup and overlays, walks all 8357 manifest records, regenerates support routes and provenance, then atomically promotes one complete tree.
copy_then_patch_risks: A manual copy would need to reproduce localizer route/origin indexes and all derived provenance fields.
Adding an overlay can change route-map, pages_runtime.js, related-images index, collection pages, and provenance; a partial patch could silently leave stale source_map identity or derivation notes.
A custom incremental path would require new production code or a second renderer and would consume the 40-minute QA/publish window.
incremental_assessment.recommendation: Use one new v25 wrapper cloned from the accepted v24 builder. Keep source15, the 179 existing overlay records, preview map, and existing collection groups frozen; append only root-accepted new primary/supplement map entries and a separately named collection-map revision. Call the unchanged export_pages API once into a new v25 output after root GO.
incremental_assessment.copy_v24_tree: Do not use as the primary build path. A byte-preserving copy can be a diagnostic comparison only; it must not be promoted or patched as a substitute for the complete exporter run.

v25_input_contract.new_sources: Only root-accepted receipt entries with original URL, SHA-256, byte length, actual capture timestamp, and validated image payload may enter the new maps.
v25_input_contract.primary_or_supplement: Classify each new item from its accepted temporal/origin metadata; later captures remain supplement entries and are never relabeled baseline primary.
map_rules: New map files are distinct from v24 maps and contain no duplicate original, route, or byte identity.
The collection map is a new clone/revision of the accepted three-group map; it preserves all old 32 images and adds only accepted images tied to a real guide/gallery group.
The six preview groups remain exactly 22 images unless root explicitly accepts a separate design change.
Every new output image must bind receipt SHA/length/timestamp, map SHA, and current provenance; no guessed aliases or dynamic full/thumb substitutions.
v25_input_contract.immutability: All v24 maps, v24 output, source15 manifest, production tools, prior acceptance receipts, and v24 ZIP remain read-only inputs.

go_sequence.action: Root accepts the neighbor retry payloads and exact source map/collection-map revision; record receipt and map SHA before any v25 output is created.
Run the v25 wrapper without --go: verify all frozen hashes, root acceptance bindings, source bytes, loader counts, disk floor, and output/partial absence.

After explicit root GO, call unchanged export_pages once with a new output path, v24 maps plus accepted new maps, unchanged preview map, and revised collection map. Preserve complete partial on post-promotion failure and never retry the export.

Run check_v25_offline.py once against the promoted output. It must prove prior 179 overlay metadata/bytes, route conservation, source/map/receipt bindings, collection counts, preview preservation, and allowlisted changed paths.
Root runs bounded browser checks for affected guide/gallery pages and old City/August/news retention, then performs publication. This local plan does not publish.

hard_stops: Do not create .scratch/pages-resources-20261016-v25 before root GO and accepted new source receipts.
Stop on any existing v25 output/partial, missing input, hash drift, disk floor breach, map overlap, or loader count mismatch.
Do not retry a failed export or replace a promoted tree; retain the exact worker receipt and ask root to decide.
Do not modify production tools, source15, v24 output/maps/receipts, root-owned acceptance/status/docs, ZIP, or release state.

helper.mode: worker-named offline checker; no export, browser, network, extraction, or publication
helper.write_scope: The optional checker receipt stays in this local directory. It never writes v25 site files.
